title: ggxy-ggZH-ampcache: an exact amplitude cache for the POWHEG-BOX-V2 process ggxy_ggZH, and a reproduction package for gg -> ZH at NLO+PS
description: Patch and C++ hash map that memoise the one- and two-loop squared amplitudes of the POWHEG-BOX-V2 process ggxy_ggZH (gg -> ZH at NLO QCD, arXiv:2603.15762) across POWHEG's event reweighting; merged into ggxy_ggZH on 2026-10-07. Event generation with a list of scale and PDF weights becomes about 24 times faster, with identical events and weights (450 events, 397800 weights compared). Version 2 adds a reproduction package for gg -> Z(ll)H at 13.6 TeV: a generator-level part without CMS software (build at pinned commits, fixed-order LO/NLO, POWHEG grids and events, cache closure, MCFM LO cross-check, reference results and checks) and a CMS part (gridpack card and recipe, Pythia8 fragments, NanoGEN validation chain with HTXS, reference results and checks).
